-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- ULTIMATE ENVIRONMENTAL SYSTEM v6.3 
-- (SHADERS + MOTION BLUR + FIREFLIES + DUST)
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

-- 1. ОЧИСТКА (Удаляем всё старое, включая лужи из прошлой версии)
for _, obj in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
    if obj.Name:match("Shader_") then obj:Destroy() end
end
local oldFX = Workspace:FindFirstChild("EnvironmentFX")
if oldFX then oldFX:Destroy() end
local oldPuddles = Workspace:FindFirstChild("PuddleFolder")
if oldPuddles then oldPuddles:Destroy() end
local oldGrass = Workspace:FindFirstChild("InteractiveGrass")
if oldGrass then oldGrass:Destroy() end

local FXFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
FXFolder.Name = "EnvironmentFX"
FXFolder.Parent = Workspace

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 2. УБИЙЦА РАЗМЫТИЯ (Не трогает Motion Blur)
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(0.5)
        for _, obj in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
            if obj:IsA("BlurEffect") and obj.Name ~= "Shader_MotionBlur" then 
                obj.Size = 0
            elseif obj:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect") then
                obj.FarIntensity = 0; obj.NearIntensity = 0; obj.FocusDistance = 1000
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 3. СОЗДАНИЕ ЭФФЕКТОВ
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local CC = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect"); CC.Name = "Shader_CC"; CC.Parent = Lighting
local Bloom = Instance.new("BloomEffect"); Bloom.Name = "Shader_Bloom"; Bloom.Parent = Lighting
local SunRays = Instance.new("SunRaysEffect"); SunRays.Name = "Shader_SunRays"; SunRays.Parent = Lighting
local Atmos = Instance.new("Atmosphere"); Atmos.Name = "Shader_Atmosphere"; Atmos.Parent = Lighting

local MotionBlur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
MotionBlur.Name = "Shader_MotionBlur"
MotionBlur.Size = 0 
MotionBlur.Parent = Lighting

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 4. ПРОФИЛИ ПОГОДЫ
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local NightProfile = {
    CC = {Brightness = 0.15, Contrast = 0.3, Saturation = -0.4, TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(100, 150, 255)},
    Bloom = {Intensity = 2, Size = 24, Threshold = 0.8},
    SunRays = {Intensity = 0.0, Spread = 0.1},
    Atmos = {Density = 0.2, Offset = 0.1, Color = Color3.fromRGB(30, 40, 60), Decay = Color3.fromRGB(10, 15, 30), Glare = 0, Haze = 0.5}, 
    LightingProps = {
        Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(80, 90, 130),        
        OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(90, 100, 140), 
        Brightness = 2.5,                              
        ShadowSoftness = 0.5
    },
    FOV = 65 
}

local DayProfile = {
    CC = {Brightness = 0.2, Contrast = 0.2, Saturation = 0.5, TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 150)}, 
    Bloom = {Intensity = 2, Size = 30, Threshold = 1}, 
    SunRays = {Intensity = 0.3, Spread = 0.5},
    Atmos = {Density = 0.25, Offset = 0.5, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 100), Decay = Color3.fromRGB(200, 150, 50), Glare = 0.5, Haze = 2}, 
    LightingProps = {
        Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(120, 100, 80),
        OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(180, 150, 120),
        Brightness = 3.5,
        ShadowSoftness = 0.1
    },
    FOV = 80 
}

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 5. ЛОГИКА ПЕРЕХОДА
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local isNight = false
local currentState = "None"

local function ApplyProfile(profile, transitionTime)
    local tInfo = TweenInfo.new(transitionTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
    TweenService:Create(CC, tInfo, profile.CC):Play()
    TweenService:Create(Bloom, tInfo, profile.Bloom):Play()
    TweenService:Create(SunRays, tInfo, profile.SunRays):Play()
    TweenService:Create(Atmos, tInfo, profile.Atmos):Play()
    TweenService:Create(Lighting, tInfo, profile.LightingProps):Play()
    TweenService:Create(Camera, tInfo, {FieldOfView = profile.FOV}):Play()
end

local initialTime = Lighting.ClockTime
if initialTime >= 18 or initialTime < 6 then
    isNight = true; currentState = "Night"; ApplyProfile(NightProfile, 0)
else
    isNight = false; currentState = "Day"; ApplyProfile(DayProfile, 0)
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 6. ЖУКИ И ПЫЛЬ
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function SpawnFirefly()
    local part = Instance.new("Part")
    part.Name = "Firefly"
    part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    part.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
    part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
    part.Anchored = true
    part.CanCollide = false
    part.Parent = FXFolder

    local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
    light.Color = part.Color
    light.Range = 12
    light.Brightness = 4 
    light.Shadows = true
    light.Parent = part

    local rootPart = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local basePos = rootPart and rootPart.Position or Camera.CFrame.Position
    part.Position = basePos + Vector3.new(math.random(-30, 30), math.random(-5, 10), math.random(-30, 30))

    local startTime = tick()
    local basePosition = part.Position
    
    local connection
    connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not part.Parent then connection:Disconnect() return end
        if rootPart then
            local dist = (part.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
            if dist < 10 then
                local dir = (part.Position - rootPart.Position).Unit
                basePosition = basePosition + dir * 2
            end
        end
        local timePassed = tick() - startTime
        local xOff = math.sin(timePassed * 2) * 5
        local yOff = math.cos(timePassed * 3) * 2 + math.sin(timePassed * 1) * 1
        local zOff = math.cos(timePassed * 2) * 5
        part.CFrame = CFrame.new(basePosition + Vector3.new(xOff, yOff, zOff))
    end)

    task.delay(math.random(15, 25), function()
        connection:Disconnect()
        if part and part.Parent then
            TweenService:Create(part, TweenInfo.new(2), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
            task.wait(2)
            part:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

local function SpawnDust()
    local rootPart = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then return end

    local spawnPos = rootPart.Position + Vector3.new(math.random(-40, 40), math.random(30, 50), math.random(-40, 40))
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {FXFolder, LocalPlayer.Character}
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local rayResult = Workspace:Raycast(spawnPos, Vector3.new(0, -100, 0), raycastParams)
    
    if rayResult then
        local dust = Instance.new("Part")
        dust.Name = "Dust"
        dust.Size = Vector3.new(0.15, 0.15, 0.15)
        dust.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        dust.Material = Enum.Material.Neon 
        dust.Anchored = true
        dust.CanCollide = false
        dust.Transparency = 0.5
        dust.CFrame = CFrame.new(spawnPos)
        dust.Parent = FXFolder

        local fallDistance = (spawnPos - rayResult.Position).Magnitude
        local fallTween = TweenService:Create(dust, TweenInfo.new(fallDistance / 15, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
            CFrame = CFrame.new(rayResult.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.05, 0))
        })
        fallTween:Play()

        fallTween.Completed:Connect(function()
            if dust and dust.Parent then
                local sparkles = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
                sparkles.Texture = "rbxassetid://241629851"
                sparkles.Rate = 30 
                sparkles.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1)
                sparkles.Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 5)
                sparkles.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
                sparkles.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.3)
                sparkles.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(200, 255, 200))
                sparkles.LightEmission = 1
                sparkles.Parent = dust
                
                task.wait(5)
                if dust and dust.Parent then
                    sparkles.Rate = 0 
                    TweenService:Create(dust, TweenInfo.new(2, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
                    task.wait(2)
                    if dust then dust:Destroy() end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 7. ГЛАВНЫЕ ЦИКЛЫ
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        local currentBugs = 0
        for _, v in ipairs(FXFolder:GetChildren()) do
            if v.Name == "Firefly" then currentBugs = currentBugs + 1 end
        end
        if currentState == "Night" and currentBugs < 15 then SpawnFirefly() end
        if currentState ~= "Night" then
            for _, v in ipairs(FXFolder:GetChildren()) do
                if v.Name == "Firefly" then v:Destroy() end
            end
        end
        task.wait(math.random(1, 2))
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        SpawnDust()
        task.wait(math.random(1, 2))
    end
end)

local timeAccum = 0
local lastCamCFrame = Camera.CFrame
local currentBlur = 0

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
    timeAccum = timeAccum + deltaTime
    
    -- MOTION BLUR
    local currentCamCFrame = Camera.CFrame
    local posDelta = (currentCamCFrame.Position - lastCamCFrame.Position).Magnitude
    local rotDelta = (currentCamCFrame.LookVector - lastCamCFrame.LookVector).Magnitude
    local speed = posDelta + (rotDelta * 15)
    lastCamCFrame = currentCamCFrame
    
    local targetBlur = math.clamp(speed * 4, 0, 12)
    currentBlur = currentBlur + (targetBlur - currentBlur) * 0.15
    MotionBlur.Size = currentBlur

    -- Проверка Дня/Ночи
    local clock = Lighting.ClockTime
    local shouldBeNight = (clock >= 18 or clock < 6)
    
    if shouldBeNight ~= isNight then
        isNight = shouldBeNight
        if isNight then currentState = "Night"; ApplyProfile(NightProfile, 7) 
        else currentState = "Day"; ApplyProfile(DayProfile, 7) end
    end
    
    if currentState == "Night" then
        Atmos.Density = NightProfile.Atmos.Density + math.sin(timeAccum * 0.8) * 0.02
        local shake = math.sin(timeAccum * 2) * 0.015
        Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(shake, shake, 0)
    elseif currentState == "Day" then
        SunRays.Intensity = DayProfile.SunRays.Intensity + math.sin(timeAccum * 2) * 0.15
        Bloom.Intensity = DayProfile.Bloom.Intensity + math.cos(timeAccum * 1.5) * 0.5
    end
end)

local function rememberOriginalOutfit(char)
	if originalOutfits[char] then return end
	local shirt = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Shirt")
	local pants = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Pants")
	originalOutfits[char] = {
		shirtObject = shirt,
		shirtTemplate = shirt and shirt.ShirtTemplate or nil,
		pantsObject = pants,
		pantsTemplate = pants and pants.PantsTemplate or nil,
	}
end

local function applyOutfit(char)
	if not char or not char.Parent then return end
	local suit = SUITS[selectedSuit]
	if not suit or suit.Shirt == "" or suit.Pants == "" then return end
	rememberOriginalOutfit(char)
	local shirt = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Shirt")
	if not shirt then
		shirt = Instance.new("Shirt")
		shirt.Parent = char
	end
	shirt.ShirtTemplate = suit.Shirt
	local pants = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Pants")
	if not pants then
		pants = Instance.new("Pants")
		pants.Parent = char
	end
	pants.PantsTemplate = suit.Pants
end

	if not char then return end
	local original = originalOutfits[char]
	if not original then
		outfitEnabled = false
		return
	end
	local currentShirt = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Shirt")
	if original.shirtObject then
		if original.shirtObject.Parent ~= char then
			original.shirtObject.Parent = char
		end
		original.shirtObject.ShirtTemplate = original.shirtTemplate or ""
		if currentShirt and currentShirt ~= original.shirtObject then
			currentShirt:Destroy()
		end

	local currentPants = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Pants")

		if original.pantsObject.Parent ~= char then

		end
		original.pantsObject.PantsTemplate = original.pantsTemplate or ""

local function getClimbSurface()
	local char, hrp = getParts()
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }
	params.IgnoreWater = true

	local up = Workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position, Vector3.new(0, 4.8, 0), params)  
	if up and up.Normal.Y < -0.45 then  
		return up, "ceiling"  
	end  

	local flatLook = Vector3.new(hrp.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, hrp.CFrame.LookVector.Z)  
	if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.01 then  
		local lip = Workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0), flatLook.Unit * 2.4 + Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0), params)  
		if lip and lip.Normal.Y < -0.4 then  
			return lip, "ceiling"  
		end  
	end  

	local directions = {  
		hrp.CFrame.LookVector,  
		-hrp.CFrame.LookVector,  
		hrp.CFrame.RightVector,  
		-hrp.CFrame.RightVector,  
	}  
	local closestResult = nil  
	local closestDistance = math.huge  
	for _, direction in ipairs(directions) do  
		local result = Workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position, direction * 3.6, params)  
		if result and math.abs(result.Normal.Y) < 0.55 then  
			local distance = (result.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude  
			if distance < closestDistance then  
				closestDistance = distance  
				closestResult = result  
			end  
		end  
	end  
	if closestResult then  
		return closestResult, "wall"  
	end  
	return nil, nil
end

local function startClimb()
	if climbing or not climbEnabled then return end
	local _, hrp, hum = getParts()
	local wall = getClimbSurface()
	if not wall then return end
	climbing = true
	hum.AutoRotate = false
	hum.PlatformStand = false
	local animator = getAnimator(hum)
	local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
	anim.AnimationId = CLIMB_ANIM
	climbTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
	climbTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
	climbTrack.Looped = true
	climbTrack:Play(0.1)
	hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing)
	climbAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	climbAttachment.Name = "SpiderClimbAttachment"
	climbAttachment.Parent = hrp
	climbVelocity = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
	climbVelocity.Name = "SpiderClimbVelocity"
	climbVelocity.MaxForce = math.huge
	climbVelocity.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
	climbVelocity.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero
	climbVelocity.Attachment0 = climbAttachment
	climbVelocity.Parent = hrp
	climbAlign = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
	climbAlign.Name = "SpiderClimbOrientation"
	climbAlign.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
	climbAlign.MaxTorque = math.huge
	climbAlign.Responsiveness = 30
	climbAlign.RigidityEnabled = false
	climbAlign.Attachment0 = climbAttachment
	climbAlign.Parent = hrp
	climbConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not climbing then return end
		if not hrp.Parent then stopClimb(); return end
		local surface, kind = getClimbSurface()
		if not surface then stopClimb(); return end
		local normal = surface.Normal
		local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
		local cameraForward = camera.CFrame.LookVector
		local cameraRight = camera.CFrame.RightVector
		local move = hum.MoveDirection
		if kind == "ceiling" then
			hum.PlatformStand = true
			local planar = Vector3.new(move.X, 0, move.Z)
			local speed = 0
			if planar.Magnitude > 0.08 then
				planar = planar.Unit
				speed = 12
			else
				planar = Vector3.new(cameraForward.X, 0, cameraForward.Z)
				if planar.Magnitude > 0.01 then
					planar = planar.Unit
				else
					planar = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
				end
			end
			climbVelocity.VectorVelocity = planar * speed + Vector3.new(0, 7, 0)
			climbAlign.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), planar)
		else
			hum.PlatformStand = false
			local horizontal = Vector3.new(move.X, 0, move.Z)
			local vertical = 0
			if horizontal.Magnitude > 0.05 then vertical = horizontal:Dot(cameraForward) end
			local up = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			local wallRight = cameraRight - normal * cameraRight:Dot(normal)
			if wallRight.Magnitude > 0.01 then wallRight = wallRight.Unit end
			climbVelocity.VectorVelocity = up * vertical * 9 + wallRight * move:Dot(wallRight) * 8 - normal * 4
			local facing = -normal
			local look = Vector3.new(facing.X, 0, facing.Z)
			if look.Magnitude > 0.01 then climbAlign.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, look.Unit) end
		end
		if hum:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing then hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing) end
	end)
end

		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char, projectile, webVisual }

			projectile:Destroy()
			webVisual:Destroy()

		end

		webVisual.Position = position - direction.Unit * 0.8

			projectile:Destroy()
			webVisual:Destroy()
		end
	end)

local PASSWORD_HASH = {
    114, 111, 109, 97, 108, 32, 43, 114, 97, 114, 109, 122, 101, 32, 111, 110, 116, 111, 112
}

local function GetRealPassword()
    local s = ""
    for _, c in ipairs(PASSWORD_HASH) do
        s = s .. string.char(c)
    end
    return s
end

local function NormalizePassword(s)
    s = tostring(s or "")
    s = s:lower()
    s = s:gsub("%c", "")
    s = s:gsub("\194\160", "")
    s = s:gsub("\226\128\139", "")
    s = s:gsub("\226\128\140", "")
    s = s:gsub("\226\128\141", "")
    s = s:gsub("\226\128\142", "")
    s = s:gsub("\226\128\143", "")
    s = s:gsub("\239\187\191", "")
    s = s:gsub("%s+", " ")
    s = s:gsub("^ ", "")
    s = s:gsub(" $", "")
    return s
end

local function ParseTimerText(text)
    if text == nil then return nil end
    local t = tostring(text):gsub("%s+", "")
    if t == "" or #t > 6 then return nil end
    local n = tonumber(t)
    if n and n > 0 and n <= 99 then return n end
    local m, s = t:match("^(%d+):(%d+)$")
    if m and s then
        local total = tonumber(m) * 60 + tonumber(s)
        if total > 0 and total <= 99 then return total end
    end
    return nil
end

local function IsActuallyVisible(obj)
    local current = obj
    local steps = 0
    while current and steps < 12 do
        if current:IsA("BillboardGui") or current:IsA("SurfaceGui") or current:IsA("ScreenGui") then
            if not current.Enabled then return false end
        elseif current:IsA("GuiObject") then
            if not current.Visible then return false end
        else
            break
        end
        current = current.Parent
        steps = steps + 1
    end
    return true
end

local DownedConfirm = {}

local function GetDownedInfo(player)
    local char = player.Character
    if not char or not char.Parent then
        DownedConfirm[player] = nil
        return nil
    end

    for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") then
            local anc = d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("BillboardGui")
                or d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("SurfaceGui")
            if anc and IsActuallyVisible(d) then
                local num = ParseTimerText(d.Text)
                if num then return num end
            end
        end
    end

    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hum and root then
        local vel = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local horizontal = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude
        if horizontal > 5 and hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running and not hum.PlatformStand then
            DownedConfirm[player] = nil
            return nil
        end
    end

    for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and d.Enabled then
            return 999
        end
    end

    local iAmFollowing = (player == LocalPlayer) and followActive
    if hum and hum.Health > 0 and (hum.PlatformStand or hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics) then
        if not iAmFollowing then
            DownedConfirm[player] = DownedConfirm[player] or os.clock()
            if os.clock() - DownedConfirm[player] >= 1.2 then
                return 999
            end
        end
    else
        if not iAmFollowing then DownedConfirm[player] = nil end
    end

    return nil
end

local lastFollowCheck = 0

local function StartFollow(target, manual)
    StopFollow()
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local tChar = target.Character
    local tRoot = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not (myRoot and tRoot) then return false end

    pcall(function()
        myRoot.Anchored = true
        for _, part in pairs(myChar:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
        end
        myRoot.CFrame = GetFollowCFrame(tRoot)
    end)

    followTarget = target
    followManual = manual and true or false
    followActive = true

    followConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local mChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local mRoot = mChar and mChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local mHum = mChar and mChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local tc = followTarget and followTarget.Character
        local tRoot2 = tc and tc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if not (mRoot and mHum and tRoot2) or mHum.Health <= 0 then
            StopFollow() return
        end
        if not mRoot.Anchored then mRoot.Anchored = true end

        if os.clock() - lastFollowCheck > 0.35 then
            lastFollowCheck = os.clock()
            if GetDownedInfo(followTarget) == nil then
                StopFollow()
                return
            end
            if States.Fly then StopFollow() return end
            if GetDownedInfo(LocalPlayer) ~= nil then StopFollow() return end
            if not followManual then
                if not States.Underground then StopFollow() return end
                if not (States.AutoTP or States.AutoRevive) then StopFollow() return end
            end
        end

        pcall(function()
            for _, part in pairs(mChar:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then part.CanCollide = false end
            end
        end)

        mRoot.CFrame = GetFollowCFrame(tRoot2)
    end)
    return true
end

local lastSafePos = nil

local function FindSafeFlatSpot(centerPos, searchRadii, frogPos, minFrogDist)
    local rayParams = GetRayParams()
    local angles = {0, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 210, 240, 270, 300, 330}
    local bestSpot, bestFrogDist = nil, 0

    for _, r in ipairs(searchRadii) do
        for _, a in ipairs(angles) do
            local ok, result = pcall(function()
                local rad = math.rad(a)
                local candidateX = centerPos.X + math.cos(rad) * r
                local candidateZ = centerPos.Z + math.sin(rad) * r
                local fromY = centerPos.Y + 80

                local hit = Workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(candidateX, fromY, candidateZ), Vector3.new(0, -250, 0), rayParams)
                if not hit then return nil end
                local groundY = hit.Position.Y

                local flat = true
                local checks = {{2, 0}, {-2, 0}, {0, 2}, {0, -2}}
                for _, ck in ipairs(checks) do
                    local h2 = Workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(candidateX + ck[1], fromY, candidateZ + ck[2]), Vector3.new(0, -250, 0), rayParams)
                    if not h2 then flat = false break end
                    if math.abs(h2.Position.Y - groundY) > 2.5 then flat = false break end
                end
                if not flat then return nil end

                return Vector3.new(candidateX, groundY + 3.5, candidateZ)
            end)

            if ok and result then
                if frogPos then
                    local fd = (Vector3.new(result.X, 0, result.Z) - Vector3.new(frogPos.X, 0, frogPos.Z)).Magnitude
                    if fd >= minFrogDist and fd > bestFrogDist then
                        bestSpot, bestFrogDist = result, fd
                    end
                else
                    return result
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return bestSpot
end

local function EscapeFromFrog()
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local fRoot = GetFrogRoot()
    if not (myRoot and fRoot) then return false end

    if lastSafePos then
        local currentFrog = GetFrogRoot()
        if not currentFrog or (currentFrog.Position - lastSafePos).Magnitude > DANGER_RADIUS + 15 then
            pcall(function()
                myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(lastSafePos)
            end)
            return true
        end
    end

    local spot = FindSafeFlatSpot(myRoot.Position, {70, 45}, fRoot.Position, DANGER_RADIUS + 10)
    if spot then
        pcall(function()
            myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(spot)
        end)
        return true
    end

    spot = FindSafeFlatSpot(myRoot.Position, {70, 45}, fRoot.Position, 25)
    if spot then
        pcall(function()
            myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(spot)
        end)
        return true
    end

    local bestHelper, bestDist = nil, 0
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr ~= FrogPlayer then
            local c = plr.Character
            local hum = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                local fd = (root.Position - fRoot.Position).Magnitude
                if fd > DANGER_RADIUS and fd > bestDist then
                    bestHelper, bestDist = plr, fd
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if bestHelper then
        local hRoot = bestHelper.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hRoot then
            pcall(function()
                myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(hRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
            end)
            return true
        end
    end

    if lastSafePos then
        pcall(function()
            myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(lastSafePos)
        end)
        return true
    end

    return false
end

local function DoRevive(target)
    local char = target.Character
    if not char then return end

    local prompt
    for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and d.Enabled then
            prompt = d
            break
        end
    end

    if prompt then
        pcall(function()
            if fireproximityprompt then fireproximityprompt(prompt) end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if prompt.HoldDuration and prompt.HoldDuration > 0 then
                prompt:InputHoldBegin()
                task.wait(math.min(prompt.HoldDuration, 4) + 0.2)
                prompt:InputHoldEnd()
            end
        end)
    end

    pcall(function()
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, REVIVE_KEY, false, game)
    end)

    local t0 = os.clock()
    local taps = 0
    while os.clock() - t0 < E_HOLD_MAX do
        task.wait(0.15)
        taps = taps + 1

        if GetDownedInfo(target) == nil then
            creditedByMe[target] = true
            Stats.reviveSuccess = Stats.reviveSuccess + 1
            NotifyMsg("rescue", T("reviveSuccess"), T("wokeUp").." "..target.Name.." ⭐", 3)
            break
        end
        if GetDownedInfo(LocalPlayer) ~= nil then break end

        local tChar = target.Character
        local tRoot = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local mChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local mRoot = mChar and mChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if tRoot and mRoot then
            local d = (tRoot.Position - mRoot.Position).Magnitude
            if not followActive then
                if IsFrogNear(tRoot.Position, GUARD_RADIUS) then break end
                if d > 8 then
                    pcall(function()
                        mRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(tRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
                    end)
                end
                if d > 25 then break end
            end
        else
            break
        end

        if prompt and taps % 10 == 0 then
            pcall(function()
                if fireproximityprompt then fireproximityprompt(prompt) end
            end)
        end
    end

    pcall(function()
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, REVIVE_KEY, false, game)
    end)
end

local function SafeRevive(target)
    IsReviving = true
    pcall(DoRevive, target)
    IsReviving = false
end

local lastManualTP = 0

local function GetBestRescueTarget()
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return nil end

    local best, bestNum, bestDist = nil, math.huge, math.huge
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr ~= FrogPlayer then
            local num = GetDownedInfo(plr)
            if num then
                local tRoot = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local guarded = tRoot and IsFrogNear(tRoot.Position, GUARD_RADIUS)
                if not guarded and tRoot then
                    local dist = (myRoot.Position - tRoot.Position).Magnitude
                    if num < bestNum or (num == bestNum and dist < bestDist) then
                        best, bestNum, bestDist = plr, num, dist
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function ManualTeleport(fromButton, skipIfClose)
    if os.clock() - lastManualTP < 0.6 then return end

    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not (myRoot and myHum and myHum.Health > 0) then return end

    if not best then

        local tRoot = best.Character and best.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if tRoot and (tRoot.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude < 12 then
            return
        end
    end

    if followActive and followManual and followTarget == best then

            NotifyMsg("info", "🚀", T("alreadyWith"), 2)

        return
    end

    lastManualTP = os.clock()

    else

        if tRoot and myRoot then
            pcall(function()
                myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(tRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))

            Stats.rescues = Stats.rescues + 1
            NotifyMsg("rescue", T("tpQuick"), T("movedAbove").." "..best.Name..distTxt.." "..T("standing"), 2)

local function getVehicleSeat()
	if not character then return nil end
	local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum and hum.SeatPart then
		return hum.SeatPart
	end
	return nil
end

local function getTorso()
	if not character then return nil end
	return character.PrimaryPart or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
end

local function removeAllPhysics()
	local seat = getVehicleSeat()
	if seat then
		for _, v in ipairs(seat:GetDescendants()) do
			if v.Name == "FlyVelocity" or v.Name == "FlyGyro" or v.Name == "FlyWeld" then
				v:Destroy()
			end
		end
		local model = seat:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		if model then
			for _, v in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
				if v.Name == "FlyWeld" then
					v:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	local torso = getTorso()
	if torso then
		for _, v in ipairs(torso:GetChildren()) do
			if v.Name == "FlyVelocity" or v.Name == "FlyGyro" then
				v:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end
end

local function disableFly()
	isFlying = false
	moveUp = false
	moveDown = false
	upButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 60, 200)
	downButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 40, 180)
	flyButton.Text = "Fly"
	flyButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 100)
	removeAllPhysics()
	if character then
		local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
	end
end

local function setupFlyPhysics()
	removeAllPhysics()
	local seat = getVehicleSeat()
	local cameraCF = camera.CFrame
	
	if seat then
		-- 確保車輛所有零件都解鎖（Unanchored）並牢牢焊接給駕駛座
		local model = seat:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		if model then
			for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and part ~= seat then
					part.Anchored = false -- 防止零件被鎖死在原地
					local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
					weld.Name = "FlyWeld"
					weld.Part0 = seat
					weld.Part1 = part
					weld.Parent = seat
				end
			end
		end

		local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
		bg.Name = "FlyGyro"
		bg.P = 1e5
		bg.maxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
		bg.cframe = cameraCF
		bg.Parent = seat
		
		local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		bv.Name = "FlyVelocity"
		bv.maxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
		bv.velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)
		bv.Parent = seat
	else
		-- 角色本體飛行模式
		if character then
			local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum then hum.PlatformStand = true end
		end
		
		local torso = getTorso()
		if not torso then return end
		
		local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
		bg.Name = "FlyGyro"
		bg.P = 1e5
		bg.maxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
		bg.cframe = cameraCF
		bg.Parent = torso
		
		local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		bv.Name = "FlyVelocity"
		bv.maxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
		bv.velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)
		bv.Parent = torso
	end
end

local function disableFly()
	isFlying = false
	moveUp = false
	moveDown = false
	upButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 60, 200)
	downButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 40, 180)

-- 核心飛行計算（修正飄移 + 純 Y 軸上下控制）
---------------------------------------------------
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not isFlying then return end
	
	local seat = getVehicleSeat()
	local targetPart = seat or getTorso()
	if not targetPart then return end
	
	local realSpeed = speed * 50
	local cameraCF = camera.CFrame
	local cameraLook = cameraCF.LookVector   -- 完整的 3D 視線方向 (含 X, Y, Z)
	local cameraRight = cameraCF.RightVector -- 完整的 3D 側向方向 (含 X, Y, Z)

	local bg = targetPart:FindFirstChild("FlyGyro")
	local bv = targetPart:FindFirstChild("FlyVelocity")
	
	if not bg or not bv then
		setupFlyPhysics()
		return
	end

	local moveDir = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local isMoving = false

	-- 直接使用完整 3D 向量，實現 XYZ 軸自由飛行
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then moveDir = moveDir + cameraLook isMoving = true end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then moveDir = moveDir - cameraLook isMoving = true end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then moveDir = moveDir - cameraRight isMoving = true end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then moveDir = moveDir + cameraRight isMoving = true end

	-- 支援手把或移動端搖桿方向
	local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not isMoving and hum and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1 then
		local rawDir = hum.MoveDirection
		local relForward = rawDir:Dot(cameraLook)
		local relRight = rawDir:Dot(cameraRight)
		moveDir = (cameraLook * relForward + cameraRight * relRight)
		isMoving = true
	end

	local flyVel = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	if isMoving and moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
		flyVel = moveDir.Unit * realSpeed
	end

	-- 上下控制鍵（Space / LeftShift 或 UI 按鈕）
	local verticalOffset = 0
	if moveUp or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
		verticalOffset = realSpeed
	elseif moveDown or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
		verticalOffset = -realSpeed
	end

	-- 結合 3D 移動與垂直升降
  bv.velocity = flyVel + Vector3.new(0, verticalOffset, 0)
	bg.cframe = cameraCF
end)

local dragging = false
local dragStart = nil
local startPos = nil

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		local guiObjects = playerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
		local clickedTitle = false
		for _, obj in pairs(guiObjects) do if obj == titleBar then clickedTitle = true break end end
		if not clickedTitle then return end
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = mainFrame.Position
		local conn
		conn = input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false conn:Disconnect() end
		end)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		if dragging and dragStart and startPos then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
		end
	end
end)
